data.title: Fundstrat's Tom Lee Says Crypto 'More Relevant' In AI Era, Backs BlackRock's Bullish Bitcoin Call
data.description: BlackRock’s latest 10-year study showed that a 1-2% allocation to Bitcoin would have improved risk-adjusted returns in a traditional 60/40 portfolio.
data.keywords: BlackRock, Tom Lee, Bitcoin, Fundstrat, Fundstrat Global Advisors
